paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Kifar: [Yevamot 11b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.11b.2). There is also R"Y ben Kipar; see their entries.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked baraita names Rabbi Yose ben Kifar as the transmitter of a teaching in Rabbi Elazar’s name.

[Heilprin’s entry on Rabbi Yose](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1919&lang=en) also cites Yevamot 11b and gives Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah’s fuller name. Hyman leaves the second notice abbreviated as ר״י and directs readers to their entries.
